title: Clocked Body Step
statement: Let $\Gamma$ be an alphabet, let $e:\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\hookrightarrow\Gamma$ be an embedding, let $M$ be a Turing machine with $k$ work tapes over $\Gamma$ and state set $S$, and let $\mathrm{stopAt}:S\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. For an input word $x$ over $\Gamma$, a configuration $c$ of $M$ on $x$, and a state $s\in S$ such that $c$ is in state $s$, let $ct:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}\,\Gamma$ be a tape content function and $cp\in\mathbb{Z}$. One step of the clocked machine from the configuration with body state $s$, underlying configuration $c$, and additional tape content $ct$ and head position $cp$ yields the configuration whose underlying machine configuration is the one-step successor of $c$, whose additional tape content and head position remain $ct$ and $cp$, and whose state is the decrement phase at the successor state if that successor is a state, and the finish state if the successor configuration is halted.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of Boolean symbols into $\Gamma$
A Turing machine $M$ with $k$ work tapes over $\Gamma$ and state set $S$
A state $s\in S$ with $c$ in state $s$
